# Game UI assets

The element corner badges and Leader Skill images in this directory come from
the public [SWARFARM](https://github.com/swarfarm/swarfarm) asset catalog.

- `elements/*.png`: cropped without redrawing from `leader_thumbnail_0.png`.
- `leader-skills/*.png`: original `leader_skill_*.png` files.

The underlying Summoners War imagery belongs to Com2uS. The files are stored
locally so the guild tool does not depend on SWARFARM's runtime availability.
